description: The Accounts page a person opens to link their Matrix id (`/link/matrix`, src/client/link-matrix.page.ts). SuperMessage builds it (`link_url`, crates/supermessage-core/src/account_link.rs) with an OpenID token the person's homeserver minted. The token rides in the fragment, which a browser never sends to a server; the page moves it to this tab's storage and wipes it from the address bar at once. SuperMessage encodes every value with everything but unreserved characters percent-escaped.

origins.description: The Accounts origin: a suite one (`https://accounts.superjackfruit.com`) or one the person set.
An Accounts on the person's own device, for development.

t.description: The OpenID access token the homeserver minted for this account (`POST /_matrix/client/v3/user/{userId}/openid/request_token`). Never logged.

s.description: The homeserver's own name for itself (`matrix_server_name`), which Accounts asks whose token it is.

app.description: `1` when an app opened the page: once linked, the page returns to the app through supermessage-linked.v1. Any other value, or none, keeps the person on the page.
